POI_TEXT.wreck: Oil still weeps from the hulls of the Great War here. Divers can recover fittings, fire-control gear and papers, if nothing else is hunting the same scrap.
POI_TEXT.base: An abandoned wartime base: fuel bunkers, workshops, maybe a hulk left at her moorings. Someone may have got here first.
POI_TEXT.site: A research station that appears on no published chart. Whatever they worked on here is worth a great deal to the right buyer.

TECH.name: Fire-control radar
TECH.desc: +15% gun range and tighter shell spread.

TECH.name: Improved sonar
TECH.desc: Sonar ships detect submarines 60% farther away.

TECH.name: Acoustic homing torpedoes
TECH.desc: Unlocks homing torpedoes, which steer onto targets ahead of them.

TECH.name: Jet aircraft
TECH.desc: Strike squadrons fly 70% faster and shrug off light flak. Unlocks the Fleet Carrier.

TECH.name: Guided missiles
TECH.desc: Unlocks anti-ship missiles, SAM launchers, the 76 mm gun and the Missile Destroyer.

TECH.name: Nuclear propulsion
TECH.desc: Unlocks the Nuclear Attack Sub, which needs no fuel.

TECH.name: Close-in weapon system
TECH.desc: Unlocks radar-directed gatling mounts that shred incoming missiles.

TECH.name: Area air defense
TECH.desc: SAM range +40%. Unlocks the Missile Cruiser.

STORY.title: Wolves at the Door
STORY.brief: Black Flag raiders are stalking Concord colliers off the Virginia capes. Find the flotilla led by the destroyer Jackal and sink it.

STORY.title: Silent Hunters
STORY.brief: A Directorate submarine pack is sinking tankers on the Halifax convoy route. Bring sonar ships (destroyers or corvettes). Submerged boats stay invisible until a sonar ship gets close.

STORY.title: The Codebook
STORY.brief: The Directorate destroyer Vigil carries a cipher machine and patrols the North Sea approaches. Sinking her gains nothing. Batter her until she strikes her colours, then take her as a prize.

STORY.title: Breaking the Skagerrak
STORY.brief: A Directorate cruiser squadron under Admiral Orlov holds the Skagerrak shut. Break it and the Baltic is open to Concord trade.

STORY.title: Iron Will
STORY.brief: The battleship Iron Will has sortied from Kiel with her screen. Sink her and Directorate sea power is broken for a generation.

commission.label: Concord Commission
commission.blurb: An old Destroyer and a Corvette under Atlantic Concord colours, based at Norfolk. The Admiralty has work for you. The Directorate will shoot on sight.

smuggler.label: Freeport Runner
smuggler.blurb: A worn Freighter and a Torpedo Boat out of Port Royal. Neutral with every flag, so every market is open to you, at least for now.

wolf.label: Lone Wolf
wolf.blurb: One war-surplus Submarine and a hand-picked crew at Halifax. Strike unseen and slip away. The Concord pays well for Directorate tonnage.

gun: Guns reload 8% faster and shoot tighter per rank
helm: +6% speed and +10% turn rate per rank
dc: -7% hull damage and -15% crew losses per rank
ord: Torpedoes, missiles and aircraft rearm 12% faster per rank
